import pytest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock

from forge_controller.config import Settings
from forge_controller.model import Ollama, ModelError


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ollama_chat_model_unavailable_error():
    settings = Settings(database='/tmp/test.db', principals={'test': {'token': 't'*40, 'agents': ['forge'], 'services': []}})
    ollama = Ollama(settings)
    
    # Mock the client to return a 503 status
    mock_response = httpx.Response(503, text='Service Unavailable')
    ollama.client = AsyncMock()
    ollama.client.stream.return_value.__aenter__.return_value = mock_response
    
    with pytest.raises(ModelError) as exc_info:
        await ollama.chat([{'role': 'user', 'content': 'test'}], [])
    
    assert 'model_unavailable' in str(exc_info.value)
    
    # Close the client
    await ollama.client.aclose()"
}
